# npa_publisher (Resource)

An NPA publisher record in the Netskope tenant. Create one for each publisher VM you intend to register; pair it with an [`npa_publisher_token`](publisher_token) to get the bootstrap token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "npa_publisher" "primary" {
  name = "pub-eu-1"
}

resource "npa_publisher_token" "primary" {
  publisher_id = npa_publisher.primary.id
}

output "token" {
  value     = npa_publisher_token.primary.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Publisher name as shown in the Netskope admin console.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) Common name reported by the publisher after first boot. Populated only when `registered = true`.
- `id` (Number) Terraform resource identifier. Equal to `publisher_id`.
- `publisher_id` (Number) Numeric publisher ID assigned by Netskope.
- `registered` (Boolean) True once the publisher has completed first-boot registration with Netskope.
- `status` (String) Current publisher status (e.g. `connected`, `not_registered`). Refreshes on read.
